purpose: Expand undersized channel catalogs with independently verified full-length playable sources before schedule generation.

requirements: Candidate is a full-length program appropriate to the channel catalog policy.
Candidate source ID is unique within the target catalog.
Candidate is not already present in the peer baseline when that would exceed the overlap threshold.
Runtime is finite and fits the channel engine slot constraints.
Media must be playable in the actual channel player; metadata alone is insufficient.
Trailers, promos, clips, removed sources, DRM-only listings, and age-gated/unembeddable sources are rejected.
Do not invent source IDs, titles, runtimes, or playability.

workflow: Read target catalog and channel source policy.
Runtime-test candidate media in the same player path used by the channel.
Add only verified candidates to the target catalog.
Generate schedule and verify active/next slots use valid catalog assets.
Run channel playback verification and HBO regression baseline.
Record source URLs/IDs, verification evidence, commit SHA, and runtime result.

requires: at least 12 unique playable target assets
runtime media evidence for newly admitted assets
